units.source_text: 听完他的感慨，早水藤左卫门摩拳擦掌，说：“

en.t: After hearing his lament, Hayami Tozaemon rubbed his fists together and said, "

units.source_text: 他们都是人面兽心的畜生。

en.t: They are all beasts with human faces and animal hearts.

units.source_text: 根本不配成为一个武士。”

en.t: They are utterly unworthy of being samurai."
